newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Coffee seen unlikely to break resistance.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Coffee seen unlikely to break resistance.

text.p: Coffee is likely to attempt a test on resistance but unlikely to succeed, analysts said.
Traders said benchmark September was due to open $20 lower, but one said it was more likely to open unchanged.
"I'd expect it to test resistance at $1,700 today, where it will most likely stall," Trevor Neil, senior analyst at Union Cal futures, said.
Only a break of the June 18 high of 1,975 would resurrect the bull market, he said.
He noted that coffee had bounced off the bottom of its February-April support band on Wednesday.
New York coffee futures ended higher on Wednesday, bolstered by speculative and local shortcovering on the heels of Tuesday's slide to more than three-month lows.
